# Feature: Run cancel and crash cleanup

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #40 -->

## Intent
NFR-007 / T-005: after stop, no runner-started child processes or temporary instrumentation remain within 10 s. Cancelled and failed runs are not baselines. Failure injection covers warm-up, measure abort, and artifact write.

## Preconditions
- Quick Scan runner and argv launcher exist (#18)
- Artifact store writes atomically under `.potato` (#5)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Abort during measure sets `cancelled` and leaves no runner-started child processes after cleanup (≤10 s)
- [ ] Warm-up crash sets `failed` with the error persisted on the artifact, not a budget fail
- [ ] Cancelled and failed artifacts have `baselineEligible: false` and cannot be treated as baselines
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Abort during artifact write still kills children; no leftover tmp outside the project root
- [ ] App-spawned grandchildren in the same process group are killed with the leader
- [ ] Cleanup never `rm -rf`s outside the potato root (P-04)

## Regression
- [ ] Happy Quick Scan still writes a schema-valid completed artifact
- [ ] Secret redaction tests still pass
- [ ] Scope: `packages/core` process manager + runner abort, scenario abort signal — no dashboard, no Windows service manager

## Assumptions
- POSIX process groups (`detached` + `kill(-pid)`) cover grandchildren that inherit the group
- User abort (AbortSignal / SIGINT) is `cancelled` with exit 0, not a budget fail

## Security Coverage
- P-04: cleanup does not delete files outside the project / `.potato` root
- P-02: warm-up errors are persisted without stack internals beyond the message
- F-03 / B-04: N/A (no tokens, no SQL)

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `createArgvLauncher` starts a detached process group and SIGTERM/SIGKILL-kills `-pid` within 10 s (then SIGKILL).
- `runScenario` accepts `AbortSignal`; abort during measure is `cancelled`, not failed.
- `finish` always kills children before artifact write; write crashes return failed/cancelled with `artifactPath: null` and `budgetFail: false`.
- Warm-up errors are stored on `run.error`. Cancelled/failed artifacts have `baselineEligible: false`.
- CLI `potato run` aborts on SIGINT/SIGTERM.
- Tests: process-group grandchildren, write crash, warmup logs, engine abort.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: abort/crash → kill process group → write cancelled/failed artifact (not a baseline).
- Missing/invalid: fail closed (failed/cancelled, no baseline). No queue/fan-out.
